title: Bromley Town Emergency Help Points
summary: Emergency medical centres, urgent care, and local river hazards for Bromley Town, BR1, and BR2.
content:
Life-threatening emergencies are always 999 first. For clinical guidance on urgent conditions, call NHS 111.

1. Nearest 24-Hour A&E Hospitals:
- Princess Royal University Hospital (PRUH), Farnborough Common, Locksbottom, Orpington BR6 8ND. From Bromley South station: ~3.5 miles south along A21; take bus 61, 261, 358, or 119 directly south (~20 min ride).
- King's College Hospital, Denmark Hill, Camberwell SE5 9RS (Nearest Major Trauma Centre). From Bromley South: ~8 miles north-west; direct Southeastern rail service to Denmark Hill or Victoria.

2. Urgent Treatment Centres:
- Beckenham Beacon Urgent Treatment Centre, 379 Croydon Road, Beckenham BR3 3QL. Open daily 08:00–20:00. From Bromley South station: ~2 miles west; take bus 227 or 352 west along Beckenham Lane (~15 min ride).

3. Local Hazards & Flood Risks:
- The River Ravensbourne flows south-to-north through western Bromley (past Queensmead Park, Shortlands, and Church House Gardens), causing low-lying flood risks along the valley bottom.
- Dense commercial development around Market Square and the railway cuttings can experience surface water flooding during heavy thunderstorms.

4. Supplies & Essentials:
- High-street dispensing chemists and major supermarkets on Bromley High Street, The Glades, Elmfield Road, and Market Square stock water, battery power items, and basic medical supplies.

Note: addresses and opening hours may have changed — confirm on arrival where possible.
